news.contents: New York Jets kicker Jason Sanders has made four field goals in three consecutive games, converting 12 of 13 attempts over that stretch. He is 25 of 28 on the season and has made all 14 attempts from inside 40 yards. Against Buffalo, he made two kicks from inside 30 yards and two from beyond 40. The longest came from 48 yards after the Jets stalled at the Buffalo 30. He also hit three from 48 yards or longer at Kansas City, including a 54-yarder.
